messages.subject: Cannot create an account on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi there,
 
I'm on a Windows 8, RStudio and i'm trying to create an account on shinyapps.io. I get into signing in with either my google account or GitHub account; both options get me to the same page that states:

 

Let's get started

You'll need an account before you can deploy any applications. Account names can contain letters, numbers and hyphens, but can't start with a hyphen or a number, and can't end with a hyphen. Pick an account name below to proceed.)

 

I've picked a dozen or so names, clicked on Save, and all I get is being brought back to this page, with no error, and nothing in the textbox. Any ideas?

thanks!
